payload.name: Extract suggestions and recommendations
payload.description: When a message contains one participant explicitly suggesting or recommending a specific item, resource, activity, or action to another participant, extract it as a memory during candidate extraction.
content: During candidate extraction, when a speaker explicitly suggests or recommends a specific item (e.g., a book, resource, activity, action) to another participant, create a memory capturing the suggestion. Include the suggested item and the stated purpose or benefit if present. Store it as an event or relationship memory, evidence-bound and source-linked to the message. Do not skip such statements because they are phrased as advice rather than assertions.

solves: The diagnosed cause is that an explicit suggestion or recommendation made by one participant to another was not extracted during candidate ingestion, leaving a gap for later questions about what someone suggested. The failure mechanism is a tendency to skip advisory statements as non-factual. A reusable rule to extract suggestions as event or relationship memories applies to any future conversation with explicit recommendations of items, resources, or actions, independent of topic.
